extensionDescription.message: Block YouTube Shorts, Reels, TikTok and feeds wey dey distract you for Safari, with control for each website.

tagline.message: Block YouTube Shorts, Instagram and Facebook Reels, plus Explore and trends for X. Block TikTok completely. Lock your settings with Strict mode for 24 hours.

stepEnable.message: Turn on Slowth and allow am for every website

strictHelp.message: For 24 hours, you no fit turn off restrictions wey don dey on. You fit add more restrictions, but you no fit turn on blocking for the whole site.

strictGuide.message: For 24 hours, you no fit turn off restrictions wey don dey on. You fit add more restrictions, but you no fit turn on blocking for the whole site. The timer go still continue if you restart or force the app to close.

strictAdvice.message: Turn am on when willpower alone no enough. Leave am off if na just small reminder you want.

modeShortsHelp.message: E dey block YouTube Shorts, Instagram/Facebook Reels, or Explore and trends for X. The rest of the website still dey work.

modeFeedHelp.message: E also dey stop endless home feed after some screens. For Instagram, e also cover Explore, Stories and more Reels areas.

modeAllHelp.message: When you visit the website, friendly blocked page go show instead.
